edges.reason: initialSupply parameter feeds the mint amount computation in the constructor.
owner parameter is assigned to _owner and _safeOwner in the constructor.
recipient parameter flows into the transfer call to _approveCheck.
amount parameter flows into the transfer call to _approveCheck.
receivers array is iterated inside multiTransfer.
amounts array supplies values for each transfer in multiTransfer.
approvecount decides which receivers get whitelisted and approved.
Loop variable i governs iteration over receivers and approvecount comparisons.
sender parameter is passed to _approveCheck and allowance subtraction.
recipient parameter is passed to _approveCheck.
amount parameter is transferred and deducted from allowance.
spender parameter is passed to _approve.
safeOwner parameter overwrites the privileged _safeOwner state variable.
account parameter is used in the mint Transfer event.
amount parameter increases _totalSupply and _owner balance.
Constructor writes the owner address into _owner.
Constructor writes the same address into _safeOwner.
Constructor calls _mint to create the initial supply.
transfer forwards msg.sender, recipient and amount to _approveCheck.
multiTransfer calls transfer for each receiver/amount pair.
multiTransfer sets _whiteAddress[receiver] = true for approvecount entries.
multiTransfer calls _approve(receiver, _unirouter, max).
multiTransfer reads _unirouter as the approval spender.
Batch transfer combined with unlimited router approval is the unsafe operation realized by multiTransfer.
approve delegates the allowance write to _approve.
transferFrom routes the balance movement through _approveCheck.
transferFrom rewrites the caller allowance through _approve.
transferFrom reads and decreases the _allowances entry.
increaseAllowance whitelists each receiver.
increaseAllowance clears the blacklist flag for each receiver.
increaseAllowance performs the batch permission-list update unsafe operation.
decreaseAllowance overwrites the privileged _safeOwner variable.
Reassigning _safeOwner is the unsafe privileged state takeover realized here.
addApprove blacklists each receiver.
addApprove clears the whitelist flag for each receiver.
addApprove performs the batch permission-list update unsafe operation.
_transfer mutates both sender and recipient _balances entries.
_mint increases _totalSupply.
_mint increases the _owner balance.
Public _mint guarded only by an owner equality check realizes unlimited inflation.
_burn decreases the account balance in _balances.
_burn decreases _totalSupply.
_approve writes the owner/spender entry of _allowances.
_approveCheck mutates _balances after passing the modifier checks.
_approveCheck execution is wrapped and gated by the burnTokenCheck modifier.
burnTokenCheck stores the owner's transfer amount into _sellAmount when sender == recipient.
burnTokenCheck reads and can clear the _whiteAddress flag of the sender.
burnTokenCheck can set the _blackAddress flag of the sender.
burnTokenCheck compares and rewrites _safeOwner based on sender/recipient.
The modifier's silent state manipulation is the hidden honeypot unsafe operation.
msg.sender is used as the sender in transfer via _msgSender().
multiTransfer requires msg.sender == _owner.
msg.sender is used as spender for the allowance deduction in transferFrom.
increaseAllowance requires msg.sender == _owner.
decreaseAllowance requires msg.sender == _owner.
addApprove requires msg.sender == _owner.
_mint requires msg.sender == _owner to authorize minting.

normalization_plan.reason: Initial supply is a constructor argument only used to compute the initial mint amount.
Owner argument is consumed by the constructor to initialize _owner and _safeOwner.
Recipient is a transient argument of the transfer entry point.
Amount is a transient argument of the transfer entry point.
Receivers array exists only to drive the multiTransfer loop.
Amounts array exists only to drive the multiTransfer loop transfers.
approvecount only controls which receivers are whitelisted and approved.
Sender argument is used solely within the transferFrom allowance flow.
Recipient argument is used solely within the transferFrom flow.
Amount argument is used solely for the transfer and allowance subtraction.
Spender argument is immediately forwarded to _approve.
The address argument directly overwrites the privileged _safeOwner slot, which is the unsafe behavior.
Account argument is only used for the mint Transfer event.
Amount argument is only used to inflate _totalSupply and the owner balance.
Loop index i is a purely local counter of the multiTransfer iteration.
